critical.explanation: PyMuPDF text extraction cannot read scanned image pages, charts, infographics, or visual presentation slides without OCR.

moderate.impact: Detected 15 repeating headers and 2 repeating footers embedded inside chunk texts.
moderate.explanation: Repeating headers and footers consume embedding space and can cause vector search to match on boilerplates rather than content.

moderate.impact: Detected 246 pages with high short-line ratios indicative of multi-column or callout box layouts.
moderate.explanation: Multi-column layouts can cause text from column A and column B to interleave horizontally depending on bounding box order.

minor.explanation: Words split across lines with hyphens (e.g. 'manage-\nment') may not match exact search terms unless normalized.
